### ROS Package

The ROS package that needs to be updated (i.e. surface/flight_control)

### Overview

This ROS package should have it's documentation updated so that it is current with the actual content of the package. This should update the README.md of the package to include all nodes and information about the package. The README.md should follow the template in `/doc/TEMPLATE.md`.

### Additional context

Add any other context about the documentation here.
